name: core.openwop.workflows.kicktodo-convene-turn
description: The KickTodo convene turn-workflow (ADR 0442 P5, ADR 0689), migrated off the in-tree `registerWorkflow(DEF)` pin site — the last PRODUCT entry in PIN_SITE_QUARANTINE, drained the way ADR 0701 and ADR 0703 drained the scheduled-chat and channel turns. chainId keeps the original workflowId so every scheduler job and run stamp keeps resolving.

chains.label: KickTodo convene turn
chains.description: Runs one convened KickTodo specialist (or KickBot's proactive guide turn) on the host-owned managed credential and posts its advisory reply into KickBot's conversation as a turn. Fired only by a scheduler job (`openwop:kicktodo.convene`, the KickBot coach turn), which supplies every parameter.

agentId.description: The convened specialist (or KickBot) to run.

task.description: The advisory task the agent runs on.

credentialRef.description: The host-owned managed credential (a chat-time tool is credential-less by design — no BYOK).

conversationId.description: The KickBot conversation the advice posts into (ADR 0125 Phase 2c).
